crossRefs.note: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you…
“But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.
Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer…
Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

translations.web: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
translations.bsb: Disaster pursues sinners, but prosperity is the reward of the righteous.
translations.kjv: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
translations.asv: Evil pursueth sinners; But the righteous shall be recompensed with good.
